pairs.target: dìyīhuí dúshù hái méi kāishǐ , zhǐ jiù pǎo le .
pairs.english: Before the first reading even began, the paper fled.
pairs.hanzi: 第一回读数还没开始，纸就跑了。

pairs.target: luò héng yòng shǒu ànzhù yìjiǎo , lìng yìjiǎo réng zài fēng lǐ chàn .
pairs.english: Lohen held one corner down, but the other still shook in the wind.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡用手按住一角，另一角仍在风里颤。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shēnshǒu qù yā , xiùkǒu yòu pèng zhe jiājù , xià dé liǎng rén tóngshí suōshǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi reached to press it down, but his cuff touched the fixture, making both pull back in alarm.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维伸手去压，袖口又碰着夹具，吓得两人同时缩手。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī méiyǒu jiào tāmen lìkè chóng lái , zhī bǎ fǎmǎ fàng huí hélǐ , ràng tāmen xiān zuò zhe kàn yíhuìer .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey did not immediately tell them to start again. She returned the weights to the box and let them sit and watch for a while.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师没有叫他们立刻重来，只把砝码放回盒里，让他们先坐着看一会儿。

pairs.target: fēng bìng búshì yìzhí chuī . péngwài de qí chuíxiàlái shí , zhuōbiān yě ānjìng ;
pairs.english: The wind did not blow constantly. When the flag outside hung limp, the table was quiet too.
pairs.hanzi: 风并不是一直吹。棚外的旗垂下来时，桌边也安静；

pairs.target: guò jǐ xī , zhǐ jiǎo xiān dòng , sōng zhe de yīdài gēnzhe sǎo guò zhuōmiàn .
pairs.english: A few breaths later, the paper corner moved first, then a loose clothing tie swept across the table.
pairs.hanzi: 过几息，纸角先动，松着的衣带跟着扫过桌面。

pairs.target: mǐlā cóng pángbiān jièlái liǎngkuài méiyǒu xiězì de báo mùbǎn , wèn néng bunéng dǎng zài wàicè .
pairs.english: Mira borrowed two thin unmarked boards nearby and asked whether they could put them on the outer side as a screen.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉从旁边借来两块没有写字的薄木板，问能不能挡在外侧。

alignment.english: put them on the outer side as a screen

pairs.target: lǎoshī shuō kěyǐ , bié tiēzhù tiěpiàn , yě bié dǎng zhe dúshù de rén .
pairs.english: The instructor agreed, provided they did not touch the strips or obstruct the reader.
pairs.hanzi: 老师说可以，别贴住铁片，也别挡着读数的人。

pairs.target: sāngè rén nuó le liǎngcì , cái bǎ fēngdǎng fàngwěn .
pairs.english: It took the three of them two adjustments to steady the windscreen.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人挪了两次，才把风挡放稳。

pairs.target: luò héng huàn dào lìngyìbiān zuò , yǐngzi búzài yāzhù kèxiàn .
pairs.english: Lohen moved to the other side, so his shadow no longer covered the scale.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡换到另一边坐，影子不再压住刻线。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān shì zhe ná qǐ shuǐbēi , quèdìng xiùzǐ hé hégài dōu yǒu dìfāng fàng , zài bǎ liǎngpiàn shúxī de tiě zhuāng huí jiājù .
pairs.english: Tavi first tried lifting his cup, making sure there was room for his sleeve and the box lid, then refitted the familiar pair of strips.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先试着拿起水杯，确定袖子和盒盖都有地方放，再把两片熟悉的铁装回夹具。

pairs.target: zhèhuí dài de shì chéng duì de xiǎoyàng , búshì péng shàng de tiědīng , yě bú pèng nàxiē shuān huò de jiù tiěhuán .
pairs.english: They had brought paired small samples, not the shelter's nails, and were not touching its old cargo-tethering iron rings.
pairs.hanzi: 这回带的是成对的小样，不是棚上的铁钉，也不碰那些拴货的旧铁环。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī hé guò zhīchéng hé jiēchùmiàn , ràng tāmen xiān guà shàng qīng fǎmǎ , děng yízhèn zài dú .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey checked the supports and contact patches and told them to attach the light weights, wait, then read.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师核过支承和接触面，让他们先挂上轻砝码，等一阵再读。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dīng zhe mòduān , méi jí zhe xúnzhǎo zìjǐ shúxī de qiānchě .
pairs.english: Tavi watched the tips without rushing to seek that familiar pull.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维盯着末端，没急着寻找自己熟悉的牵扯。

pairs.target: tāmen bǎ méiyǒu shī zuò shí de wèizhì jìxià , qǔ xià fǎmǎ , yòu guà yícì , liǎnghuí xiānghé , cái wǎng xià yíbù zǒu .
pairs.english: They recorded the untouched positions, removed the weights, and hung them again. Only when both readings agreed did they proceed.
pairs.hanzi: 他们把没有施作时的位置记下，取下砝码，又挂一次，两回相合，才往下一步走。

pairs.target: děng lǎoshī shìyì , tǎ wéi bǎshǒu fàngshàngqù . yìbiān shāoshāo xiàchén , lìngyìbiān wǎnghuí tái .
pairs.english: At the instructor's signal, Tavi placed his hands on the strips. One side sank slightly and the other rose back.
pairs.hanzi: 等老师示意，塔维把手放上去。一边稍稍下沉，另一边往回抬。

alignment.english: placed his hands on the strips

pairs.target: tā zuò de réng shì wūlǐ nà yìdiǎn shì , bèihòu què yǒu jījiào , yǒu yùnhuò gōng lājǐn bǎngdài de shēngyīn , háiyǒu fēng cóng mùbǎn biān zuānjìnlái , chuī liáng shǒuwàn .
pairs.english: He was still doing that same little thing from indoors, but behind him were chickens, freight workers tightening straps, and wind slipping around the boards to cool his wrists.
pairs.hanzi: 他做的仍是屋里那一点事，背后却有鸡叫，有运货工拉紧绑带的声音，还有风从木板边钻进来，吹凉手腕。

pairs.target: luò héng bào wán , tǎ wéi jiéshù jiēchù .
pairs.english: When Lohen finished calling the readings, Tavi ended contact.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡报完，塔维结束接触。

pairs.target: liǎngbiān huíqù , tā hái zuò le yíhuìer , cái bǎshǒu cóng zhuōshàng shōu jìn xiùzǐ .
pairs.english: Both sides returned. He sat a while longer before drawing his hands into his sleeves.
pairs.hanzi: 两边回去，他还坐了一会儿，才把手从桌上收进袖子。

pairs.target: zhǐjiān méiyǒu má , zhǐshì liáng . lǎoshī ràng tā yòngbù cāgān , búzài jiā zuò ,
pairs.english: His fingertips were cold, not numb. The instructor told him to dry them with a cloth and do no more.
pairs.hanzi: 指尖没有麻，只是凉。老师让他用布擦干，不再加做，

pairs.target: jīntiān yào liú de shì yìzǔ néng jiǎngqīng tiáojiàn de jìlù , búshì zuì duō de cìshù .
pairs.english: Today's aim was one record whose conditions they could explain, not the most attempts.
pairs.hanzi: 今天要留的是一组能讲清条件的记录，不是最多的次数。

pairs.target: shào lǐ zài lìngyìtóu niē zìjǐ de mǔzhǐ .
pairs.english: At the other end, Shaoli was pinching his thumb.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里在另一头捏自己的拇指。

pairs.target: xiāng dài yā guò de dìfāng fāhóng , tā gāngcái wèile téng zhuōzi , yòu bǎ liǎngzhī xiāngzǐ dié zhe bān le yìhuí .
pairs.english: The strap had left a red patch; while making room for the table, he had carried both boxes stacked together again.
pairs.hanzi: 箱带压过的地方发红，他刚才为了腾桌子，又把两只箱子叠着搬了一回。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī wèn tā xiàwǔ nà lún háiyào buyào zuò , tā shuō xiǎng zuò , suíhòu shēnshǒu jiǎn diànpiàn , dìyī xià què méi niē qǐlái .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey asked whether he still wanted his afternoon turn. He said yes, then reached for a washer but failed to pick it up at first.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师问他下午那轮还要不要做，他说想做，随后伸手捡垫片，第一下却没捏起来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn le , méiyǒu tì tā jiǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi saw and did not pick it up for him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见了，没有替他捡。

pairs.target: shào lǐ shì dìèr xià yǐqián , zìjǐ bǎshǒu shōuhuí qù , shuō jīntiān xiān jì biérén de .
pairs.english: Before trying again, Shaoli withdrew his hand himself and said he would record for others today.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里试第二下以前，自己把手收回去，说今天先记别人的。

pairs.target: lǎoshī ràng tā xiūxi , zài kàn shǒuzhǐ yǒuméiyǒu huīfù , jīntiān bú zuò jiēchù liànxí .
pairs.english: The instructor told him to rest, then check whether his fingers recovered; no contact practice today.
pairs.hanzi: 老师让他休息，再看手指有没有恢复，今天不做接触练习。

pairs.target: shào lǐ diǎntóu , yǎnjīng què hái zài nà tào liángjù shàng . tǎ wéi xiǎngdào tā xiàgèyuè de kǎoqī , méi shuō shǎo yícì méishénme ;
pairs.english: Shaoli nodded but kept looking at the instruments. Thinking of his exam next month, Tavi did not say one missed turn was nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里点头，眼睛却还在那套量具上。塔维想到他下个月的考期，没说少一次没什么；

pairs.target: duì yǒuxiē rén , shǎo yícì jiùshì shǎo yícì .
pairs.english: For some, one missed turn was simply one missed turn.
pairs.hanzi: 对有些人，少一次就是少一次。

pairs.target: shōu hé shí , tǎ wéi bǎ jiāndài shàngjuàn zhe de hòu bù chōuchū yíbàn , wèn tā yào buyào diàn zhe .
pairs.english: While packing, Tavi pulled half the thick cloth from his shoulder strap and offered it as padding.
pairs.hanzi: 收盒时，塔维把肩带上卷着的厚布抽出一半，问他要不要垫着。

pairs.target: shào lǐ jiēguò qù , zhé le liǎngzhé , shuō huíchéng hái tā .
pairs.english: Shaoli took it, folded it twice, and said he would return it in the city.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里接过去，折了两折，说回城还他。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō búyòng jí , zìjǐ lìngyìbiān háiyǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi said there was no hurry; he still had some on the other side.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说不用急，自己另一边还有。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī yuē lái bāngmáng huí yùn qìcái de jiǎofū dào le .
pairs.english: The porter Instructor Jian had hired to help carry the equipment back arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师约来帮忙回运器材的脚夫到了。

pairs.target: liǎng rén bǎ xiāngzǐ fēnkāi , zhòng de jiāogěi tā , shào lǐ zhī ná jìlù jiá .
pairs.english: They separated the boxes and gave him the heavy one; Shaoli carried only the record folder.
pairs.hanzi: 两人把箱子分开，重的交给他，邵里只拿记录夹。

pairs.target: zhè shízhōng yòu xiǎng le . shǒu péng de nǚrén tīng wán liǎngshēng , zǒu dào yán wài lā le yìgēn shéng ,
pairs.english: The bell rang again. After hearing two notes, the keeper stepped under the outer eaves and pulled a rope.
pairs.hanzi: 这时钟又响了。守棚的女人听完两声，走到檐外拉了一根绳，

pairs.target: jìnchù de zhōngshēng yíxià gàizhù shāngǔ lǐ de huíyīn .
pairs.english: The nearby bell suddenly drowned the valley's echoes.
pairs.hanzi: 近处的钟声一下盖住山谷里的回音。

pairs.target: tā bǎ lán qí huàn le gè guà fǎ , jiào děng chē de rén bǎ sǎnjiàn shōu hǎo , bié dào le gēnqián cái zhǎo shéng tóu .
pairs.english: She changed how the blue flag hung and told the waiting travelers to pack their loose items instead of searching for cord ends when the cart arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 她把蓝旗换了个挂法，叫等车的人把散件收好，别到了跟前才找绳头。

pairs.target: jīlóng lǐ de jī bǐ rén xiān nàoqǐlái . yùnhuò gōng bǎ bǔ hǎo de bǎngdài kòu shàng , lǎotàitài yì shǒufú lóng , yìshǒu cóng huáilǐ mō piào .
pairs.english: The chickens made a fuss before the people. The freight worker fastened the repaired strap while the old woman steadied her basket and searched inside her coat for her ticket.
pairs.hanzi: 鸡笼里的鸡比人先闹起来。运货工把补好的绑带扣上，老太太一手扶笼，一手从怀里摸票。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái kànqīng , qí shàng nà kuài bǔdīng bìng búshì tóng yìzhǒng lán , lí yuǎn què jīhū kànbùchūlái .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi see that the flag's patch was a different blue, though almost invisible from far away.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才看清，旗上那块补丁并不是同一种蓝，离远却几乎看不出来。

pairs.target: nài lěi jiùshì zhèshíhòu cóng xiàpō zǒushàng lái de .
pairs.english: That was when Nerai came up the slope.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾就是这时候从下坡走上来的。

pairs.target: tā kùjiǎo zhān zhe shī cǎo , shǒulǐ ná zhe yìxiǎo dié lùbiāo chāo jì ,
pairs.english: Wet grass clung to her trouser hems, and she held a small stack of route-marker notes.
pairs.hanzi: 她裤脚沾着湿草，手里拿着一小叠路标抄记，

pairs.target: xiān tóng shǒu péng de rén shuō le liǎngjù , cái kànjiàn tāmen de ǎi zhuō .
pairs.english: She spoke briefly with the keeper before noticing their low table.
pairs.hanzi: 先同守棚的人说了两句，才看见他们的矮桌。

pairs.target: " hé lùchū lái méiyǒu ? " tā wèn . tǎ wéi shuō yěxǔ kànjiàn le , méi gǎn rèn .
pairs.english: “Did the river show itself?” she asked. Tavi said he might have seen it, but hadn't dared identify it.
pairs.hanzi:
“河露出来没有？”她问。
塔维说也许看见了，没敢认。

pairs.target: tā shuō nà jiù xiàhuí zài kàn , zhèhuí méi kànjiàn yě búshì bái zǒu .
pairs.english: She said to look again next time; failing to see it today did not make the walk wasted.
pairs.hanzi: 她说那就下回再看，这回没看见也不是白走。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ chàlù de jìlù gěi tā kàn , tā zhǐzhe qízhōng yíchù , shuō mùpái yǐjīng huàn guò , jiù zì hái liúzài shí shàng ,
pairs.english: Iven showed her his fork records. Pointing to one, she said the wooden sign had been replaced, but the old words remained on stone.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把岔路的记录给她看，她指着其中一处，说木牌已经换过，旧字还留在石上，

pairs.target: nánguài tāmen huì chāo chū liǎnggè jiàofǎ .
pairs.english: No wonder they had copied two names.
pairs.hanzi: 难怪他们会抄出两个叫法。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī guòlái tīng , wèn shuí guǎn de xīn pái ,
pairs.english: Instructor Jian came to listen and asked who managed the new sign.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师过来听，问谁管的新牌，

pairs.target: tā bǎ fùzé de zhànmíng xiěgěi tā , méiyǒu dāngchǎng tì liǎngtiáo jìlù bìng chéng yìtiáo .
pairs.english: She wrote the responsible station's name for him without immediately merging the two records.
pairs.hanzi: 她把负责的站名写给他，没有当场替两条记录并成一条。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ xuéxiào dìxià nàduàn méi duànkāi de tiě , wèn tā shìbushì wàimiàn de jiù dōngxī dōu yǒurén zhīdào .
pairs.english: Remembering the still-connected iron beneath the school, Tavi asked whether someone knew all the old things outside.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起学校地下那段没断开的铁，问她是不是外面的旧东西都有人知道。

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ bǐmào gài huíqù , shuō ruò dōu zhīdào , tā jīntiān jiù búbì lái duì lùbiāo .
pairs.english: Nerai replaced the pen cap and said that if everything were known, she needn't have come to compare markers today.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把笔帽盖回去，说若都知道，她今天就不必来对路标。

pairs.target: shuōwán yòu bǔ yíjù , bù zhīdào de bùzhǐ zài wàimiàn .
pairs.english: Then she added that the unknown was not only outside.
pairs.hanzi: 说完又补一句，不知道的不止在外面。

pairs.target: yuǎnchù chēlún xiǎng qǐlái , pénglǐ de rén máng zhe qǐshēn .
pairs.english: Cart wheels sounded in the distance, and the travelers hurried to rise.
pairs.hanzi: 远处车轮响起来，棚里的人忙着起身。

pairs.target: tā bǎ lù ràngkāi , bāng lǎotàitài tuō le yíxià jīlóng dǐ .
pairs.english: She moved aside and supported the bottom of the old woman's chicken basket.
pairs.hanzi: 她把路让开，帮老太太托了一下鸡笼底。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn tā de bái pái cóng lǐngkǒu huá chūlái , yòu hěnkuài bèi tā sāi huíqù , miǎnde guà zhù lóng tiáo .
pairs.english: Tavi saw her white tally slip out of her collar, then she quickly tucked it back to keep it from catching on the basket slats.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见她的白牌从领口滑出来，又很快被她塞回去，免得挂住笼条。

pairs.target: lǎotàitài méiyǒu kuā tā , zhī jiào tā xiǎoxīn nà zhī ài zhuó shǒu de .
pairs.english: The old woman did not praise her, only warned of the one that liked pecking hands.
pairs.hanzi: 老太太没有夸她，只叫她小心那只爱啄手的。

pairs.target: nà zhī jī guǒrán shēncháng bózi , nài lěi jíshí suōshǒu , cháo tā dèng le yìyǎn .
pairs.english: Sure enough, the chicken stretched its neck; Nerai withdrew her hand in time and glared at it.
pairs.hanzi: 那只鸡果然伸长脖子，奈蕾及时缩手，朝它瞪了一眼。

pairs.target: wǔhòu lìngyìzǔ dào shí , tāmen yǐjīng chī wán dàilái de bǐng .
pairs.english: By the time the next group arrived that afternoon, they had finished their packed bread.
pairs.hanzi: 午后另一组到时，他们已经吃完带来的饼。

pairs.target: dé mǎ kànjiàn fēngdǎng xiān wèn shì shuí xiǎngdào de , mǐlā jǔ le shǒu , tǎ wéi zhǐzhǐ tā , méiyǒu bǎ tā suàn chéng zìjǐ de liànxí chéngjì .
pairs.english: Dema saw the windscreen and asked whose idea it was. Mira raised her hand; Tavi pointed to her without counting it toward his own practice achievement.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛看见风挡先问是谁想到的，米拉举了手，塔维指指她，没有把它算成自己的练习成绩。

pairs.target: jiāojiē wán , liǎngzǔ zài lùbiān jǐ zhe ràng le yíliàngchē , cái gèzì wǎng gāi qù de fāngxiàng zǒu .
pairs.english: After the handover, both groups squeezed to the roadside to let a cart pass before going their separate ways.
pairs.hanzi: 交接完，两组在路边挤着让了一辆车，才各自往该去的方向走。

pairs.target: huíchéng de pō bǐ chū chéng shí nán zǒu .
pairs.english: The slope back to the city was harder than on the way out.
pairs.hanzi: 回城的坡比出城时难走。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō tú shàng kě méiyǒu duōchū zhème yíduàn , mǐlā ràng tā bǎ zhǐ zài zhé gāo yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Iven said no extra stretch had appeared on his map. Mira told him to fold the paper higher again.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说图上可没有多出这么一段，米拉让他把纸再折高一点。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào dé chuǎnqì , tíngxiàlái děng luò héng , jiānshàng shǎo le xiāngzǐ , tuǐ què xiàng hái bèizhe tā .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed until he panted, then stopped for Lohen. His shoulders were free of the box, but his legs felt as if they still carried it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑得喘气，停下来等洛衡，肩上少了箱子，腿却像还背着它。

pairs.target: dào qǐnshì shí tiān hái méi hēi .
pairs.english: It was not yet dark when he reached his room.
pairs.hanzi: 到寝室时天还没黑。

pairs.target: tā xiān bǎ wàzi fānchūlái liàng , suíhòu náchū xìnzhǐ , xiě jīntiān zài yún shàngmiàn zǒulù .
pairs.english: First he turned out his socks to air, then took paper and wrote that today he had walked above the clouds.
pairs.hanzi: 他先把袜子翻出来晾，随后拿出信纸，写今天在云上面走路。

pairs.target: xiě wán yòu juéde bú duì , tāmen zǒu de shì shítoulù , yún zài xiàmiàn .
pairs.english: After writing it, he thought it wrong: they had walked on a stone road, with clouds below.
pairs.hanzi: 写完又觉得不对，他们走的是石头路，云在下面。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu huàdiào zhěngjù , zhī zài hòumiàn tiān le bàn xíng , zài xiě nàlǐ de hòuchē rén yě yào děng chē , yǒu yìzhī jī chàdiǎn zhuó dào nài lěi de shǒu .
pairs.english: He did not cross out the whole sentence, only added half a line, then wrote that travelers there also waited for carts and a chicken had almost pecked Nerai's hand.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有划掉整句，只在后面添了半行，再写那里的候车人也要等车，有一只鸡差点啄到奈蕾的手。
